hypothesis: A compressed metadata-work predictor permits separate modeling of minimum-token transitions, admission work, and the unusually expensive all-greedy admission regime.

pcvs.expression: int(self.batch_update_builder.batch_changed) * (12 + 4 * (int(not self.all_greedy) + int(not self.no_top_p) + int(not self.no_top_k) + 3 * int(not self.no_penalties) + int(not self.no_allowed_token_ids)) + (4 + self.num_reqs if not self.no_penalties else 0))
pcvs.name: metadata_work_units
pcvs.rationale: Combines metadata setup, tensor copies, and penalty prompt construction into approximate work units, freeing features for processor transitions.

pcvs.expression: int(len([ids for ids in self.req_output_token_ids if ids is not None and len(ids) <= 1]) > 0)
pcvs.name: minimum_token_transition
pcvs.rationale: Separates minimum-token mask transitions, which the previous report associates with roughly 60000 additional instructions.

pcvs.name: addition_work
pcvs.rationale: Represents both fixed admission setup and per-request processor initialization.

pcvs.name: greedy_admission
pcvs.rationale: Separates admission into an all-greedy batch, which showed substantially greater residual cost than other admissions.
